summary: Phase 2 ERP (suppliers CRUD + comparator, no-code rules engine + alerts, enriched analytics with profit/ROAS/ROI/ops, enriched product catalog fields, ad-spend setting) and Phase 1.5 one-click AI optimize fully validated. 26/26 backend pytest cases pass (1 skipped when no alert exists to resolve — expected). Frontend admin flows all render and integrate with backend: suppliers create+score comparator, rules create+run+toast, analytics KPIs (kpi-gross-profit, kpi-roas, ops-to-ship, ops-alerts, chart-monthly) all present, per-product ai-optimize-{id} buttons (23 found) and enriched product form (form-margin, form-supplier, buy_price/brand/sku/ean/weight/dimensions/supplier_url/video_url/subcategory) all wired.

issues: Cookie/consent banner (Nous utilisons des cookies...) shown on /admin routes for logged-in admin — consider suppressing on internal admin pages. Non-blocking for tests.

action_items: (Optional) Hide cookie consent banner on /admin routes for logged-in admin
(Optional) Return `results` structure consistently from cj/import-bulk even when pids=[] to match documented contract (currently 503 if CJ key missing — acceptable per spec)
critical_code_review_comments: erp.py: rules engine is O(rules*products); acceptable for now (5k product cap) but consider indexing db.products on stock_total/in_stock/active for scale.
erp.py _matches for low_margin ignores products without buy_price/cost_price (returns None) — good, but no way for admin to see excluded products in the run report.

ops.py analytics: revenue_monthly month key uses `f"{y}-{m:02d}"` while orders' created_at is ISO — works because created_at[:7] matches; if timezone offsets differ it could shift monthly attribution.

ai.py optimize_product_core writes ai_optimized=true only when rewrite section succeeds; if rewrite fails but score succeeds, ai_optimized flag stays false — arguably fine but inconsistent with the 'done' array.
server.py BulkImportInput.optimize field is accepted but if CJ key is missing endpoint 503s before checking pids — could early-return {results: []} for pids=[] to allow contract testing without CJ.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST_ prefixed supplier + rule + product created and deleted within tests. UI test created 1 supplier + 1 rule (TEST_UI_* prefixed) that remain in DB for admin visual verification.
